title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - IFRS17 Life - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Name And Description**
**Senior, Life Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Senior to join our Life Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Senior Consultant, you will:
  
  

* Responsible for delivering high quality results and generating effective and impactful solutions
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality, consistently driving projects to completion and ensuring that work is of high standard

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Good analytical skills
* Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems.
* Hands-on experience in actuarial valuation software Prophet will be added advantage. Advanced level experience in Prophet will be valuable
* Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
* In-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of US / EMEIA / APAC markets
* Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work
* Self-motivation and proactiveness in driving project
* Willingness to travel to meet and work with clients

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Experienced resource – preferably 3-6 years
* Experienced in the following topics: Actuarial reserving, Assumption setting, Modelling software

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience of working with Prophet, MG ALFA, GGY Axis, Moses, RAFM, etc.
* Knowledge of IFRS 17, US GAAP, Solvency II and other insurance regulations around the globe
* Preferred Actuarial Degree / Good exam progress
* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree ideally business, actuarial or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* AI Literacy – Good knowledge on GenAI, Agentic AI would be an added advantage

**What We Look For**

* Good communication skills
* English fluent in speaking
* Good English writing skills
* Experience of leading/supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building industry relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Credit Controller
description:
**Company Description**
PKV A$OCIATES | Compatriot Consultants (Contact Strictly through WhatsApp @ 9496439703) is a professional services firm focused on delivering reliable finance and business support solutions to clients across diverse sectors. The organization emphasizes strong financial governance, compliance, and operational efficiency to help clients manage risk and improve performance. Team members work in a structured yet collaborative environment, with opportunities to contribute to client-facing projects and internal process improvements. The firm values integrity, accuracy, and client service, creating a workplace where finance professionals can build their expertise and grow their careers.

**Role Description**
The Credit Controller role is a full-time, on-site position based in Kochi. The Credit Controller will monitor customer accounts, evaluate creditworthiness, and ensure timely collection of outstanding payments. Day-to-day responsibilities include tracking debtors, following up on overdue accounts, resolving billing and payment queries, and maintaining accurate records in financial systems. The role involves preparing credit reports, coordinating with finance and sales teams, and recommending credit limits and terms based on risk assessments. The Credit Controller will also support month-end closing activities, contribute to cash flow forecasting, and help refine credit control procedures to reduce bad debt and improve collection efficiency.

**Qualifications**

* Strong credit control and debt collection skills, including experience managing debtor accounts and overdue payments.
* Knowledge of credit management practices, such as assessing creditworthiness and setting appropriate credit limits and terms.
* Solid finance foundations, including understanding of accounts receivable, cash flow, and basic accounting principles.
* Proficiency with spreadsheets and financial software, and ability to maintain accurate, well-organized records.
* Effective communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to handle difficult conversations professionally.
* Attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a structured approach to prioritizing multiple accounts and deadlines.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field is preferred.
* Experience in a similar credit control or finance role, particularly within corporate or consulting environments, is an advantage.

* Support mapping of G/L accounts to financial statement items.

* Help identify data issues or inconsistencies and support resolution with reporting units.

* Experience in system implementation/fine-tuning, cloud deployment and project delivery.

* Exceptional command over spoken and written English.

* Ability to multi-task, work well under pressure with commitment to deliver under tight deadlines.

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Finance, Statistics, Economics or a related quantitative field; advanced degree preferred.
* 3 to 5 years of relevant experience working with business consulting firms.

title: Payroll Operations Services Manager
description:
**Join us on a journey of endless possibilities**
At
**Strada**
, possibility isn’t just a promise – it’s the foundation of everything we do. We believe in unlocking potential for every colleague, creating a journey of growth, discovery, and impact.
  
  
With the support, resources, and opportunities we provide, you’ll build a fulfilling future – working on meaningful projects that span industries and regions, contributing to outcomes that matter.
  
  
Strada is a people, payroll, and technology leader simplifying international workforce management. Operating in 180+ countries, we design and deliver
**people-first**
solutions powered by cloud-based technology – helping organizations grow and enabling workforces to perform at their best.
  
  
**Learn more at**
www.stradaglobal.com
  
  
The Payroll Operations Services Manager (OSM) provides end-to-end oversight of payroll operations for assigned clients and serves as the primary operational escalation point. The OSM coordinates delivery teams, third-party providers, Client Service Leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to meet contractual obligations and service commitments. The OSM leads operational health, service-level performance, payroll change execution, audit readiness, financial and resource management, service recovery, and continuous improvement. The OSM is also a people leader who develops aligned payroll colleagues to deliver consistent, compliant, and client-focused outcomes.
  
  
Core Accountabilities
  
  

* Payroll Service Delivery Oversight
* Provide oversight for day-to-day payroll delivery across service locations, platforms, internal teams, and third-party providers.
* Monitor payroll workload, critical processing activities, capacity, dependencies, risks, and open items to ensure business-as-usual work and projects meet required deadlines and quality standards.
* Lead payroll status calls and key client-event planning, including annual and recurring payroll activities including Union agreement changes, bonus cycles, year-end operations, legislative changes, mergers and acquisitions, and changes in scope.
* Ensure consistent execution of operating procedures, controls, contractual requirements, and approved service delivery practices.
* Evaluate orphaned or unclear work to define the process, establish ownership, or eliminate unnecessary activity.
* Lead operational readiness and stabilization activities for new services, transitions, vendor changes, and material payroll initiatives.
* Client Delivery and Service Partnership
* Partner with the CSL to ensure governance actions, service priorities, and client commitments are completed accurately and on time.
* Build trusted relationships with key client contacts and serve as the secondary operational contact for payroll delivery matters.
* Participate in and, as appropriate, lead client governance meetings, operational reviews, and status calls, presenting payroll performance, risks, actions, and recommendations.
* Provide payroll operational consultation, recommendations, and best-practice guidance to support changes, releases, and legislative or tax updates.
* Coordinate timely client communications regarding payroll operations, delivery risks, service improvements, resource changes, and other business initiatives impacting payroll delivery.
* Governance, Metrics, and Operational Health
* Monitor payroll operational health and performance across aligned clients and teams, driving achievement of established service and operational targets.
* Analyze dashboards, productivity data, operational metrics, open-item reporting, and service results to identify trends, emerging risks, performance gaps, and improvement opportunities.
* Prepare payroll governance materials, service metrics, and operational scorecards, ensuring assigned content is accurate, complete, and ready for stakeholder review.
* Develop and coordinate mitigation and recovery plans for missed targets, operational risks, escalating concerns as appropriate.
* Escalation Management, Service Recovery and E&O
* Serve as the primary escalation point for payroll service delivery issues and high-impact or highly visible service failures.
* Coordinate issue investigation to determine root cause, impacted population, operational and client impact, risk exposure, and required corrective actions.
* Develop and coordinate service recovery and mitigation plans, ensuring actions are tracked through completion and appropriate stakeholders are engaged.
* Coordinate Root Cause Analysis documentation and coordinate required internal review, approval, and client delivery.
* Initiate and support Errors and Omissions processes, ensuring required documentation is completed and coordinating with the CSL and applicable stakeholders to mitigate financial and client impacts.
* Review and track service recoveries, corrective actions, and recurring issues to identify trends and drive process improvement and risk-reduction opportunities.
* SLA, Contract, Risk and Compliance Management
* Serve as the payroll operational subject matter expert for aligned Statements of Work, service commitments, SLA definitions, calculations, targets, and contractual obligations.
* Monitor SLA, KPI, and other contractual performance, coordinating root cause analysis, remediation, recovery actions, and reporting when performance targets are not met.
* Ensure payroll delivery remains within contractual scope and identify potential scope creep or work requiring a Change Request.
* Conduct applicable risk-based audits and ensure required payroll controls are executed, monitored, and maintained in accordance with established control requirements.
* Coordinate and actively participate in SOC1 audits, control assessments, evidence collection, remediation activities, and other applicable compliance reviews.
* Maintain payroll Business Continuity plans for aligned clients and coordinate required testing, recovery exercises, and execution during business continuity events.
* Change Requests, Projects, and Continuous Improvement
* Provide oversight for payroll Change Request activities, including intake, operational scoping, assumptions, work estimates, testing requirements, and implementation readiness.
* Validate detailed payroll scope, requirements, and estimates for work owned by the aligned service area, including estimates prepared by delivery teams.
* Coordinate with the CSL, impacted domains and service areas, vendors, Finance, and project resources to support end-to-end Change Request delivery.
* Manage payroll-specific projects when a dedicated project manager is not assigned, maintaining appropriate plans, risks, issues, actions, and status reporting.
* Identify and implement opportunities for standardization, automation, global sourcing, demand reduction, capacity creation, and process improvement.
* Ensure process documentation, training, knowledge transfer, and appropriate monitoring are completed to support the effective transition and sustainability of new or improved processes.
* Financial and Resource Management
* Monitor variable charges, resource utilization, headcount and cost for Global team, time recording, non-colleague costs, project hours, and other financial drivers for assigned clients, identifying variances and taking appropriate action.
* Identify and implement cost-management, global sourcing and efficiency opportunities while balancing client commitments, control requirements, colleague capacity, and service quality.
* Manage global sourcing partner performance through regular scorecard reviews, service oversight, root cause analysis, and implementation of opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce costs
* Develop and maintain resource and staffing plans based on delivery requirements, anticipated demand, workload, risk, and required skills and capabilities.

Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.

As a Senior Consultant within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  
**On engagements, you will:**

* Be responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality and ensuring that work is of high standards
* Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Actively look for automation and AI enhancement opportunities

* Actuarial liability estimation for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR models using the data supplied for estimation
* Working knowledge of different loss projection methods and their applications along with the familiarity of different property and casualty lines of business
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Be able to build models from scratch
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Perform ad-hoc research and development requests as required
* Preparations of report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise
* Knowledge of ARIUS, ResQ or similar reserving software is desirable, but not mandatory
* Exposure to data analytics tools such as SQL and Alteryx is an added advantage
* Familiarity with IFRS 17 or Solvency II frameworks is preferred
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.

* Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 3+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a small team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, Alteryx, etc., will be a plus
* AI proficiency, automation mindset
* Good exam progress

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Overseas exposure (US, UK, AU market experience)
* AI Literacy – Good knowledge on GenAI, Agentic AI would be an added advantage

**What We Look For**
Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent big 4 experience in leading actuarial engagement with recognized insurers will be an advantage. This ideally should be complemented by employment experience within the Insurance sector either at an insurer, intermediary or regulator
  
  
Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
  
  
Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

title: Finance Manager
description:
Finance Manager

**Company:**
G8 Indo Gulf Pvt Ltd

**Location:**
Kochi, Kerala, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-time | On-site

**Salary:**
₹60,000–₹90,000 per month, depending on experience and skills

About G8 Indo Gulf Pvt Ltd

G8 Indo Gulf Pvt Ltd is a solutions-driven company bringing together engineering, fabrication, logistics, and construction capabilities to serve clients across diverse sectors. The company is committed to delivering high-quality, integrated services while maintaining strong financial management, operational efficiency, and sustainable business growth.

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented
**Finance Manager**
to oversee the company's financial operations, accounting, reporting, taxation, and compliance functions.

The ideal candidate will have strong financial and analytical skills, practical knowledge of accounting and taxation, and the ability to support management in financial planning and business decision-making.

This role offers an excellent opportunity for a finance professional to take ownership of financial operations and contribute directly to the company's growth.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Financial Management & Reporting**

* Oversee day-to-day accounting and financial operations.
* Prepare and review financial statements, management reports, and MIS reports.
* Monitor cash flow, working capital, receivables, and payables.
* Prepare budgets, financial forecasts, and variance analysis.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to management.

**2. Accounting & Internal Controls**

* Ensure accurate and timely maintenance of books of accounts.
* Establish and monitor effective internal financial controls.
* Review accounting entries, reconciliations, and financial transactions.
* Coordinate month-end and year-end financial closing activities.
* Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes and financial efficiency.

**3. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Oversee GST compliance, including return preparation and filing.
* Ensure compliance with TDS and applicable income tax provisions.
* Coordinate statutory audits, tax audits, and other financial reviews.
* Ensure timely completion of statutory filings and other regulatory requirements.

**4. Working Capital & Business Support**

* Monitor project costs, expenses, and profitability.
* Manage cash flow planning and working capital requirements.
* Analyse financial performance and identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Support management in financial planning, business strategy, and decision-making.
* Coordinate with banks, auditors, consultants, vendors, and other stakeholders as required.

Eligibility Criteria

* **Qualification:**
  CA Intermediate or CMA Intermediate qualified.
* **Experience:**
  Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in accounting, finance, and financial management.
* Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, taxation, and statutory compliance.
* Practical experience in financial statements, MIS reporting, budgeting, and cash flow management.
* Good working knowledge of GST, TDS, and other applicable statutory compliances.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting software.
* Strong analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage responsibilities, and coordinate effectively with management and other departments.

Candidates with experience in engineering, fabrication, construction, project-based businesses, or related industries will be preferred.

Compensation

**₹60,000–₹90,000 per month**
, depending on the candidate's experience, technical expertise, and skill set.

How to Apply

Interested candidates who meet the above criteria are invited to apply through LinkedIn with their updated CV.

* **Join G8 Indo Gulf Pvt Ltd and contribute to our financial management and business growth.**

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Manager – FDI**
**EY – GDS – Consulting – Finance**
As a Manager in our EY Finance Consulting Team, you will lead client engagements focused on leveraging finance data intelligence and finance data lake solutions to drive strategic performance improvements. You will manage techno-functional assessments of finance data processes, lead analysis of data challenges, and design innovative, data-driven finance solutions. Your role will involve collaborating with senior client stakeholders across industries and geographies to unlock actionable insights from finance data and enable data-driven decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced Manager with deep expertise in finance data intelligence, finance data lakes, and finance process optimization. Candidates should have strong knowledge of corporate finance processes, ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.), and finance data analytics. Experience in FP&A, Financial Accounting, and Reporting domains is highly desirable. This role offers a unique opportunity to lead and grow EY’s global finance data intelligence service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead finance function engagements covering Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and Order to Cash (O2C) processes, focusing on finance data flows, reconciliations, journals, transaction matching, variance analysis, intercompany transactions, and fixed assets accounting.
* Drive workshops and stakeholder interviews to perform comprehensive current state (As-Is) finance data process assessments and design optimized future state processes leveraging finance data lakes and advanced analytics.
* Identify and prioritize finance data process improvement opportunities through automation, data integration, technology upgrades, and finance data transformation initiatives.
* Oversee the implementation and development of finance data lakes, data pipelines, and governance frameworks.
* Design and implement KPIs, dashboards, and control frameworks for finance data monitoring and reporting across O2C, P2P, and R2R processes.
* Translate complex business requirements into technical data models and solutions, ensuring alignment with client objectives.
* Lead data profiling, data quality assessments, and validation activities using SQL, Excel, and analytics tools.
* Ensure comprehensive documentation of finance data processes, data models, and project deliverables.
* Collaborate with project managers, cross-functional teams, and senior client stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
* Apply strong accounting expertise to interpret financial reports and statements in the context of data analytics and governance.
* Provide guidance on financial consolidation, cost allocation, finance planning, and budgeting processes as they relate to data integration.
* Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close activities with a focus on data accuracy and reconciliation.
* Possess in-depth technical knowledge of ERP systems (SAP ERP/HANA, Oracle GL) and finance data structures.
* Lead Chart of Accounts (CoA) design and finance data architecture initiatives.
* Manage and mentor junior consultants and analysts on finance data intelligence projects.
* Effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

title: Accountant
description:
**Company Description**
Bellwether Consultancy Services Private Limited is a multidisciplinary consulting firm that delivers engineering and design services for industrial, commercial, and residential projects. The company’s expertise spans process, architectural, civil, structural, mechanical, piping, electrical, and instrumentation & control works. Powered by experienced engineers and technocrats, Bellwether focuses on process-oriented technology projects and close collaboration with clients to provide fast, effective technical support for plant modifications, expansions, and proposals. Bellwether emphasizes dedication, industry expertise, and commitment to fulfilling customer needs and building lasting goodwill.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Accountant role based in Kochi. The Accountant will manage day-to-day financial transactions, including accounts payable and receivable, general ledger entries, and bank reconciliations. The role involves preparing and reviewing invoices, maintaining accurate financial records, and supporting month-end and year-end closing activities. The Accountant will assist in preparing financial statements, reports, and budgets, ensuring compliance with relevant accounting standards, tax regulations, and internal policies. * Prior experience in an engineering, consulting, or project-based environment is beneficial.

title: Senior Executive – Revenue (Kochi)
description:
**About The Team**
We are building a high-performance Revenue & Marketing pod — a geography-focused business unit that owns end-to-end top-line and bottom-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.

**What You Will Do**

* Revenue & P&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course-correct with data

* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth & Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install-not-transacted user cohorts

* Promote high-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography

* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health & Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop-offs — with revenue-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics & Reporting
* Maintain a real-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions

**Who We Are Looking For**
Must Have
  
  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution [IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 1–3 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e-commerce operations, or P&L-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment

Good to Have
  
  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e-commerce, Q-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on-ground activation

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

title: SAP Group Reporting - Senior
description:

**Position Title: GROUP REPORTING - Senior**

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

* Configuration of Balance carry forwards and Currency translation methods.
* Experience in configuring inter-unit eliminations/reclassification and Manual eliminations.

* Should have more than 3-7 years of relevant experience in managing and implementing the Consolidation Projects on BPC / BCS / ECCS / BOFC and 2 years on Group Reporting.
* Consolidation Assist in monthly, quarterly and annual reporting for Group and its subsidiaries.
* Good understanding on IFRS & local GAAP accounting standards.
* Understand client requirements, provide solutions, functional specifications and configure the group reporting system accordingly.
* Strong configuration hands on experience along with sound functional knowledge in performing the legal consolidation.
* Manage the process for consolidating the submissions entities across the Group to produce a single set of consolidated financial results for the Group.
* Assist in the mentoring and development of graduates within the Group Financial team.
* SAP Consolidation experience is must. The candidate must have experience on BPC, SEM-BCS, EC-CS, FI-LC, as well as ECC with a solid accounting and finance background.
* Knowledge/Hands on experience for configuring various objects in SAP FICO (at least one project).
* Ability to configure SAP S / 4 HANA Group Reporting on premise / cloud and deliver work products / packages meeting the client's standards and requirements.
* Experience in configuring /defining the Following in the S / 4 HANA Group.

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

title: Assistant Manager - Entertainment PRS, Malayalam
description:
* Job Summary To work with the Sales team to support part of the business of the respective cluster. The incumbent will act as a key link between Programming/Content team and Sales teams and drive the brand philosophy and sales/revenue strategy for the channel to maximize revenue. This will be done through effective forecasting, planning, pricing and property integrations based on deep understanding of customer needs and patterns.

The incumbent will play a critical role in developing a comprehensive roadmap and vision for our business, studying industry-specific trends, and creating compelling narratives to drive monetization growth. This role requires a strategic thinker with strong analytical and communication skills, as well as the ability to navigate complex organizational dynamics.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities
* Creating revenue business plan across portfolio, defining the pricing strategy along with the Channel PRS Head for the channel/cluster basis organization objectives, budget for the year, market scenario, competition, etc. in order to ensure the sales organization achieves overall revenue target.
* Driving the channel pricing agenda - setting benchmarks, providing inputs and sign-offs on deals, and participating in deal negotiations as and when required
* Build client wise strategy/ deal structuring for the channel which includes creating and recommending client pricing options for individual client deals, building monthly client packages including decisions on what time bands to allocate to each client based on what works for their target segments and track deviations in delivery
* Build sponsor packages for impact shows and ensure maximum monetization for each property on the channel
* Build band wise revenue budget, show and property wise pricing including determination of sponsor packages
* Create and maintain strategies based on key genres to help understand the genre behavior, trends, movements etc. that may have impact on business.
* Building bottom-up revenue plans for the fiscal, quarter & month
* Tracking performance vs. annual plan, revising forecasts etc.
* Developing insights into the genre & channel deliveries to develop customized pitches for clients
* Creating & implementing trade marketing agenda for the channel – Mailers, On Air promos, Trade events etc.
* Define a measurement process to ensure that client and agency are aligned on key performance metrics, establishing realistic business goals, and providing frontline support through reporting and analytics
* Impact landscape sizing of a particular genre – understand the kind of impact properties across channels, changes and evolutions compared to the previous year and deeper understanding of the advertisers who buy impact
* Engage with sales teams for ensuring revenue rationalization by forecasting projections/trends for a healthy business and designing attractive packages for the sales team to take to the market, conducting roadshows. Prepare the sales team so they can handle queries from clients and media planners/buyers with confidence.
* Supporting ad sales team with operational tasks on rate cards, internal deal approvals, client sales proposals etc.

title: Pricing Analyst - US Mortgage
description:
**Pricing Analyst - US Mortgage**

Job Description:
Pricing Analyst - US Mortgage

**Job Summary**

The Pricing Analyst manages mortgage rate lock requests, pricing, lock changes, extensions, relocks, and cancellations according to company policies, investor guidelines, and market pricing. The role involves coordinating with Loan Officers (LOs), Loan Processors (LPs), Secondary Marketing, underwriting, and investors to ensure accurate pricing, timely lock execution, and compliance with established procedures. The analyst also reviews daily investor rate sheets, maintains pricing accuracy in mortgage systems, investigates and resolves pricing discrepancies, and supports the smooth functioning of the mortgage lock desk.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Mortgage Rate Lock Management:

Process rate lock requests from Loan Officers (LOs) and Loan Processors (LPs), verify loan details (amount, program, interest rate, LTV, FICO, occupancy, property type, and lock period), ensure eligibility and compliance with company policies and investor guidelines, and accurately process new locks, changes, extensions, relocks, and cancellations on time. Monitor lock expirations, communicate confirmations, rejections, and required corrections, and maintain accurate records in the loan origination system.

2. Mortgage Pricing and Rate Sheet Management:

Download and review daily investor rate sheets for dates, pricing adjustments, product availability, and lock periods. Upload and maintain rate sheets and pricing data in the pricing engine. Compare investor pricing with internal systems to identify differences. Review base pricing, loan-level price adjustments (LLPAs), margins, concessions, discount points, and lender credits. Calculate and verify final borrower or broker pricing according to company policies. Provide accurate pricing information to Loan Officers for eligible loan scenarios.

3. Lock Extensions, Relocks, and Pricing Exceptions:

Review and process lock extensions, relocks, and pricing exceptions according to company policies. Calculate extension fees, relock fees, and pricing adjustments. Check lock history, expiration dates, previous extensions, and available free extension days. Process pricing concessions and exceptions only after obtaining the required approvals. Verify approval authority and maintain supporting documents. Communicate applicable fees, pricing impacts, and processing restrictions to the requesting teams.

4. Investor Guidelines and Product Eligibility:

Review investor guidelines and product eligibility before processing lock requests. Verify delegated and non-delegated lending channels, where applicable. Confirm product availability based on loan program, credit score, occupancy, LTV, loan purpose, and other applicable criteria. Identify investor-specific restrictions and escalate exceptions when needed. Coordinate with investor representatives to resolve pricing, eligibility, and lock-related issues. Ensure all pricing and lock activities follow investor requirements and internal policies.

5. Communication and Issue Resolution:

Respond to inquiries from Loan Officers, Loan Processors, Secondary Marketing, and other internal teams. Explain pricing differences, lock rejections, extension fees, and investor restrictions clearly. Follow up on pending lock requests, pricing exceptions, and unresolved system issues. Escalate complex pricing and eligibility concerns to the appropriate manager or authorized approver. Maintain professional communication and meet established service-level agreements (SLAs).

6. Quality Control and Reporting:

Maintain accurate records of lock requests, confirmations, extensions, relocks, cancellations, and pricing exceptions. Check loan details and pricing for accuracy. Prepare daily or periodic reports on lock activity, expiring locks, pending requests, and pricing issues. Follow internal controls, audit requirements, and documentation standards.

**Required Qualifications**

A Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.

At least 1 year of experience in U.S. mortgage operations, Secondary Marketing, or mortgage rate lock desk operations is preferred.

Knowledge of mortgage pricing, rate locks, extensions, relocks, cancellations, and Conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, and applicable Non-QM products is required, along with Excel, Microsoft Office, and pricing analysis skills.

Strong analytical, numerical, problem-solving, and communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple requests under tight deadlines are essential.

**Key Competencies & Performance Metrics**

• Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills.

• Accuracy in mortgage pricing, rate locks, extensions, and relocks.

• Good time management, prioritization, and attention to detail.

• Effective communication, teamwork, and knowledge of investor guidelines and compliance requirements.

• Timely processing of lock requests, quick resolution of pricing issues, and adherence to company policies and service-level agreements (SLAs).

• Accurate documentation, audit readiness, and reduction of processing errors.

**Work Schedule & Location**

Must be available to work according to U.S. mortgage business hours, including the applicable U.S. time zone and market-related deadlines.

Shift Time: 7:30pm to 4:30am IST

Location: Inforpark Phase 2, Kochi

Candidates from Kerala and Tamil Nadu are preferred.

**Staff, P&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Staff member to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Staff member within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines
*.*
**On engagements, you will:**

* Be responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Seniors, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Maintain/develop productive working relationships with stakeholders and other team members

**Within the actuarial practice you will:**

* Estimate actuarial liability for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR model using the data supplied for estimation
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Updating the report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise
* Knowledge of ARIUS or similar reserving software is desirable, but not mandatory
* Exposure to data analytics tools such as SQL and Alteryx is an added advantage
* Familiarity with IFRS 17 and Solvency II frameworks is preferred
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**
Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
  
  
**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 1+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, Alteryx etc, will be a plus
* Good exam progress

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

**What We Look For**

* Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting.
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Lock Desk Analyst – U.S. Mortgage
description:
**The Lock Desk Analyst manages mortgage rate lock requests, pricing, lock changes, extensions, relocks, and cancellations according to company policies, investor guidelines, and market pricing. The role involves coordinating with Loan Officers (LOs), Loan Processors (LPs), Secondary Marketing, underwriting, and investors to ensure accurate pricing, timely lock execution, and compliance with established procedures. The analyst also reviews daily investor rate sheets, maintains pricing accuracy in mortgage systems, investigates and resolves pricing discrepancies, and supports the smooth functioning of the mortgage lock desk.**

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Mortgage Rate Lock Management: 

 

Process rate lock requests from Loan Officers (LOs) and Loan Processors (LPs), verify loan details (amount, program, interest rate, LTV, FICO, occupancy, property type, and lock period), ensure eligibility and compliance with company policies and investor guidelines, and accurately process new locks, changes, extensions, relocks, and cancellations on time. Monitor lock expirations, communicate confirmations, rejections, and required corrections, and maintain accurate records in the loan origination system.

 

2. Mortgage Pricing and Rate Sheet Management: 

 

Download and review daily investor rate sheets for dates, pricing adjustments, product availability, and lock periods. Upload and maintain rate sheets and pricing data in the pricing engine. Compare investor pricing with internal systems to identify differences. Review base pricing, loan-level price adjustments (LLPAs), margins, concessions, discount points, and lender credits. Calculate and verify final borrower or broker pricing according to company policies. Provide accurate pricing information to Loan Officers for eligible loan scenarios.

 

3. Lock Extensions, Relocks, and Pricing Exceptions: 

 

Review and process lock extensions, relocks, and pricing exceptions according to company policies. Calculate extension fees, relock fees, and pricing adjustments. Check lock history, expiration dates, previous extensions, and available free extension days. Process pricing concessions and exceptions only after obtaining the required approvals. Verify approval authority and maintain supporting documents. Communicate applicable fees, pricing impacts, and processing restrictions to the requesting teams.

 

4. Investor Guidelines and Product Eligibility: 

 

Review investor guidelines and product eligibility before processing lock requests. Verify delegated and non-delegated lending channels, where applicable. Confirm product availability based on loan program, credit score, occupancy, LTV, loan purpose, and other applicable criteria. Identify investor-specific restrictions and escalate exceptions when needed. Coordinate with investor representatives to resolve pricing, eligibility, and lock-related issues. Ensure all pricing and lock activities follow investor requirements and internal policies. 

5. Communication and Issue Resolution: 

 

Respond to inquiries from Loan Officers, Loan Processors, Secondary Marketing, and other internal teams. Explain pricing differences, lock rejections, extension fees, and investor restrictions clearly. Follow up on pending lock requests, pricing exceptions, and unresolved system issues. Escalate complex pricing and eligibility concerns to the appropriate manager or authorized approver. Maintain professional communication and meet established service-level agreements (SLAs).

 

6. Quality Control and Reporting: 

 

Maintain accurate records of lock requests, confirmations, extensions, relocks, cancellations, and pricing exceptions. Check loan details and pricing for accuracy. Prepare daily or periodic reports on lock activity, expiring locks, pending requests, and pricing issues. Follow internal controls, audit requirements, and documentation standards.

 

**Required Qualifications**

* A Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.
* At least 1 year of experience in U.S. mortgage operations, Secondary Marketing, or mortgage rate lock desk operations is preferred.
* Knowledge of mortgage pricing, rate locks, extensions, relocks, cancellations, and Conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, and applicable Non-QM products is required, along with Excel, Microsoft Office, and pricing analysis skills.
* Strong analytical, numerical, problem-solving, and communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple requests under tight deadlines are essential.

 

**Key Competencies & Performance Metrics**

* Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills.
* Accuracy in mortgage pricing, rate locks, extensions, and relocks.
* Good time management, prioritization, and attention to detail.
* Effective communication, teamwork, and knowledge of investor guidelines and compliance requirements.
* Timely processing of lock requests, quick resolution of pricing issues, and adherence to company policies and service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Accurate documentation, audit readiness, and reduction of processing errors.

**Work Schedule & Location**

**Must be available to work according to U.S. mortgage business hours, including the applicable U.S. time zone and market-related deadlines.**

Shift Time: 7:30pm to 4:30am IST

 

Location: Inforpark Phase 2, Kochi

title: Independent Director
description:
**What this Board needs protected**

The institution's licence to grow rests on the quality of its lending, funding, customer treatment and control environment. The independent director will sit across the Audit, Risk, NRC and CSR agenda, bringing the ability to see how a commercial decision migrates through credit behaviour, liquidity, collections, provisioning, reputation and regulatory accountability.

This is not a role for a specialist who views risk only through policy limits. The Board requires an individual who can interrogate portfolio movement at cohort and segment level, recognise when apparent stability is being produced by restructures or collection practices, and judge whether capital and liquidity remain adequate under a plausible operating shock. The director must also understand that conduct failures can begin in target design, vendor incentives or digital journeys long before they become complaints.

**The mandate in practice**

The appointee will challenge credit strategy using vintage curves, roll rates, concentration, collection efficiency, loss emergence and collateral realisation rather than a single gross-NPA number. Product approval papers should show the customer need, risk appetite consumed, operational readiness, model limitations, adverse-case economics and accountable owner after launch.

Funding and asset-liability oversight will require close attention to tenor mismatches, refinancing dependence, encumbrance, covenant headroom and liquidity under name-specific stress. The director should insist that contingency actions are executable within the time shown in the stress test—not merely available in theory.

On Audit Committee matters, the member will examine expected-credit-loss governance, management overlays, write-offs, income recognition, related parties, securitisation or assignment accounting, technology access and third-party assurance. On the Risk Committee, the same person must connect those accounting judgements to appetite, collections, fraud, cyber events and operational resilience.

Customer outcomes form a separate line of responsibility. The Board should see complaints by root cause, repeat incidence, vulnerability, channel, product and resolution quality. Outsourced sales, field collection, recovery agents, digital consent and grievance handling must be governed as extensions of the institution, not as vendor matters.

**Questions candidates should be ready to answer**

* When can rapid portfolio growth make the headline delinquency ratio temporarily more reassuring rather than more informative?
* What evidence would cause you to challenge a management overlay even when the external auditor accepts it?
* How do you test whether a liquidity contingency plan can be executed during simultaneous market and reputation stress?
* Which early conduct indicators belong at Board level before a regulator or ombudsman trend is visible?
* How would you distinguish healthy digital underwriting from a model whose exclusions are producing unfair or unstable outcomes?

**Appointment standard**

Candidates may come from regulated lending, banking, insurance, credit bureau, risk, finance or supervisory backgrounds. They should have held enterprise accountability for a balance sheet, credit portfolio, treasury, risk framework or regulated operation. The Board values evidence of independent challenge, remedial follow-through and clear communication under regulatory scrutiny. A valid DIN and completion of statutory independent-director databank obligations are required by appointment. Expect quarterly meetings, committee preparation, an annual risk workshop and occasional availability for material regulatory or liquidity events.

title: Project Planner
description:
**Job Title**
Project Planner
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
The Project Planner will be responsible for developing, monitoring, and controlling project schedules for large-scale hotel, resort, and hospitality construction projects. The role will ensure effective planning, progress tracking, resource optimization, and timely project delivery while supporting project leadership with accurate forecasting and reporting.
  
  
**Job Description**
About the Role:
  
  

* Develop, maintain, and monitor integrated project schedules for construction projects from design through handover.
* Prepare detailed project plans, work breakdown structures (WBS), resource-loaded schedules, critical path analyses, and project progress reports using Primavera P6 and/or MS Project.
* Coordinate with project managers, consultants, architects, contractors, and stakeholders to ensure alignment of project milestones and deliverables.
* Track project performance against baseline schedules, identify delays and risks, and recommend recovery plans and mitigation strategies.
* Generate periodic progress reports, dashboards, earned value analysis, and executive presentations to support project decision-making.
* Review contractor schedules, evaluate extension of time (EOT) claims, and monitor compliance with contractual project timelines.
* Support cost and project controls teams through schedule integration, forecasting, and planning-related analyses.

**About You**

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 6 years of relevant experience in project planning and scheduling for commercial construction projects.
* Strong expertise in MS Project, project controls, critical path methodology (CPM), and project scheduling techniques.
* Proven experience in managing complex hospitality development projects from concept/design stage through construction and commissioning.
* Excellent analytical, reporting, stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Knowledge of construction contracts, claims management, risk assessment, and project control best practices.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with multiple stakeholders and project teams.

Why Join Us?
  
  

* Opportunity to work on prestigious hotel, resort, and hospitality developments across diverse locations.
* Exposure to large-scale projects with international standards and best-in-class project management practices.
* Strong focus on professional development, technical training, and career growth opportunities.
* Collaborative and inclusive work environment that values innovation, excellence, and continuous improvement.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where every individual is respected and valued. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities for everyone.

title: EY Business Consulting - Supply Chain Domain - Enterprise Asset Management - Senior Consultant
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY Business Consulting – Supply Chain Domain - Enterprise Asset Management - Senior Consultant**
At EY, our objective is to help clients improve the performance and productivity of their Supply Chain & Operations (SC&O). With expertise in leading Enterprise Asset Management frameworks, you will help clients to effectively manage both the physical and non-physical assets through the entire lifecycle, maximising performance and productivity whilst reducing the total cost of operations / ownership.
  
  
The client base spans across industries and includes multinational companies in oil & gas, power & utilities, government, banking, consumer goods & retail, manufacturing etc.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a passionate Senior Consultant with expertise in
**Enterprise Asset Management (EAM)**
to join the group within our
**Business Consulting**
sub-service line and work with clients and project teams in EAM engagements. The role focuses on asset centric transformation covering governance, lifecycle strategy, performance optimization, and digital enablement—helping clients maximize asset value, optimize TOTEX, improve reliability, and strengthen decision-making across the asset lifecycle.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Senior Consultant, you will be part of a team of professionals with extensive consulting and industry experience. Drawing on your knowledge and experience, you will create innovative insights for clients, bringing software / digital solutions and strategies to optimise their asset management capabilities and sustain performance improvement. As an influential member of the team, you will help create a positive learning culture; coach, counsel, and nurture junior team members.
  
  
An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain, and strengthen internal and external relationships. Travel may be required based on business/client requirement.
  
  
Typically, you will work across below EAM service offerings:
  
  
**Governance and Assurance**

* Design Asset Governance frameworks and Target Operating Models aligned to business strategy and regulatory requirements
* Conduct ISO 55001 alignment assessments and EAM maturity diagnostics
* Develop risk, control, and performance assurance frameworks across asset lifecycle processes
* Integrate ESG considerations into asset strategies, governance models, and performance reporting

**Lifecycle Strategy & TOTEX Optimization**

* Develop Strategic Asset Management Plans (SAMPs) and asset class level AM plans
* Design and document EAM processes, policies, and procedures across the end to end asset lifecycle
* Support asset investment planning, prioritization, and portfolio optimization
* Define value frameworks and TOTEX optimization approaches linking Capex, Opex, risk, and performance
* Support asset decommissioning strategies and transition planning

**Asset Performance & Reliability**

title: Finance Relationship Owner-FRO

**Assistant Director - Finance Relationship Owner**
The Finance Relationship Owner (FRO) serves as a key member of the Global Controlling Decision Support Finance team, supporting the Global Entities in managing financials end to end and achieving financial objectives. Serving as a key member of the Global Controlling team, the FRO teams co-ordinates with stakeholders in the business and various Finance support structures to provide analytical support, functional expertise, reporting solutions, transaction processing and sharing of best practices.

This role acts as a single point of contact providing financial information and analysis to stakeholders within a Global Function or Service Line. The FRO communicates with executive level business leaders and is expected to demonstrate an implicit understanding of their clients’ needs. In addition to Function/Service Line Executives, key customers are CFOs, their Deputies and teams who are involved in managing budgets. FROs interface and manage relationships between the Function/Service Line Team and Global Controlling.

* Communicates regularly with Function/Service Line Teams on financial operating performance and is responsible for identifying issues and supporting resolution of same.
* Monitors and tracks financial results against goals and historical performance leveraging reports from the Reporting Center of Excellence (COE).

* Works with Functions/Service Lines to develop budgets, taking overall ownership of this budget process. Liaises with Sub Function/Service Line Leaders to define targets for Sub Function/Service Lines. Challenges, reviews and consolidates annual budgets and forecasts/projections for Functions/Service Lines.

**Experience:**

* Must have at least 2 end\-to\-end implementation experience and strong hands\-on experience in SAP Treasury and Risk Management (TRM) module.

* Experience in Cash Management, Bank Communication Management (BCM), and In\-House Cash (IHC)
* Good understanding of Credit Risk, financial instruments, and exposure management.

title: Stock Market TrainerKottayam ,Kochi (Kerala)
company: ICFM - Institute of Career In Financial Market (Unit of Career Pro Ventures Ltd)
description:
**Job Title: Stock Market Trainer** 




**Location: Kottayam, Kochi** 
 ,
 **Kerala** 




**About ICFM:** 




 ICFM is a premier institute in financial market education, empowering students, traders, and professionals with practical, industry\-oriented knowledge to build successful careers in the stock markets. We specialize in hands\-on training with real\-time market exposure across Equity, Derivatives, Technical Analysis, Fundamental Analysis, and other financial market segments.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 




 \* Conduct classroom and online training sessions on various financial market segments including Equity, Derivatives (F\&O), Technical Analysis, and Fundamental Analysis.
 



 \* Train students on stock market concepts such as market operations, chart analysis, indicators, candlestick patterns, Futures \& Options, risk management, portfolio building, and trading psychology.
 



 \* Prepare students for NISM/NCFM certification modules through structured training and exam\-oriented preparation.
 



 \* Develop and update training content, study materials, mock tests, assignments, and practical learning modules.
 



 \* Provide live market demonstrations using trading platforms and explain real\-time market movements and trading opportunities.
 



 \* Guide students in developing trading and investment strategies with proper risk management techniques.
 



 \* Explain market concepts related to intraday trading, swing trading, positional trading, long\-term investing, and portfolio diversification.
 



 \* Keep training content updated as per current market trends, SEBI regulations, and exchange guidelines.
 



 \* Mentor students for career opportunities, internships, and professional growth in financial markets.
 



**Requirements:** 




 \* Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Commerce, or a related field.
 



 \* NISM/NCFM certifications preferred.
 



 \* Strong knowledge of Equity, Derivatives, Technical Analysis, and Fundamental Analysis.
 



 \* Minimum 2–3 years of experience in stock market trading, investing, portfolio management, or financial market training.
 



 \* Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to explain complex market concepts clearly.
 



 \* Hands\-on experience with live markets, trading platforms, and market analysis tools.
 



**Key Skills:** 




 \* Equity \& Derivatives Market Training
 



 \* Technical \& Fundamental Analysis
 



 \* Futures \& Options Concepts
 



 \* Risk Management \& Portfolio Building
 



 \* Live Market Analysis
 



 \* Trading \& Investment Strategies
 



 \* NISM / NCFM Training
 



 \* Student Mentorship \& Financial Market Education
